items.q: Hamp was still with him, and let's see, Ziggy Elman (PHONETIC) was with him, Harry James

ctx.x: Well, was Hamp still with Goodman then?
Yeah. Hamp was still with him, and let's see, Ziggy Elman (PHONETIC) was with him, Harry James, and -- I'm trying to think of the tenor players. That was the old Benny Goodman band.
Bud Freeman was with him for a while.
